title: Gareb
summary: Scabby; itch. (1.) One of David's warriors (2 Sam. 23:38), an Ithrite.

inlines.v: Scabby; itch. (1.) One of David's warriors (2 Sam. 23:38), an Ithrite.
(2.) A hill near Jerusalem (Jer. 31:39), probably the hill of lepers, and consequently a place outside the boundary of the city.
